answer: A reef monitoring network can stop a garden of invented agents from multiplying influence by assigning voting weight to bonded capital, never to account count. Splitting one bond across a hundred keys leaves total weight unchanged. At each audit pulse, proven double-signing burns the responsible stake, so an attacker must acquire and risk real capital. This limits identity splitting rather than proving unique people; wealthy holders can dominate, and faulty evidence or concentrated stake can undermine the defense.
